$comment: A minimal provider of observation items (EDP 1.0, docs/External-Data-Protocol.md). Documentation only: Foresignal does not load this file.
manifest: register it with POST /v1/external/sources {"manifest": ..., "approve": true}; the source becomes ext-river-gauges-example.
batch: push it with POST /v1/external/sources/ext-river-gauges-example/items and the ingest key (X-Foresignal-Ingest-Key).
Each observation becomes one record {stream}:{id} of the stream's kind; seriesKey + t name the point; knownAt says when the value became knowable (availability is max(knownAt, receipt)).
bindings: the atomic stream does nothing until bound; target series makes series:ext-river-gauges-example/river-level/{seriesKey} for change points, event studies and charts.
